tei:div.tei:p: zhwa dmar sku phreng gnyis pa

mkha' spyod dbang po'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa gnyis pa dpal mkha' spyod dbang po ni/ byang gnam gzhung gi bye ma lung na kha bar pa bya ba yab lha rgyal dang yum 'brog mo'i sras su lcags pho stag lo la bltams/ zla ba bdun lon pa na rje rang byung rdo rje me tog kha ma bye ba 'dzin pas/ me tog rnam par smin yang kha ma bye// dal 'byor snying po thob kyang stobs ma rgyas// rang gi ngo bo mthong yang tha mal pa// da ni rtag tu mthong ba bsten bya bu// zhes gsungs pa na dad pas lus 'phar zhing mchi ma'i rgyun byung bas yab yum sogs 'jigs sngangs dang ngo mtshar du gyur/ yang zhag bdun phrag gcig na bla mas se gol lan gsum mdzad pa mthong bas/ skye ba snga ma gsum gsal bar dran te cung zad gsungs pas/ dad ldan gyi skye bo dag 'dus shing bkur/ zla bcu bzhi tsam lon pa na/ gnam rtsen lding grog mor/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje pheb ste/ skye bo mang pos mchod pa na ri'i sgang zhig na yum gyi drung na gnas pas mthong ste dngos su mchi bar ma nus pas phyag 'tshal zhing sngon gsungs pa'i tshig gi mthar/ kye ma da ni byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes bshums shing gsol ba btab pas/ dbu gdugs kyi steng du drung gi sku 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba yun ring du gzigs/ yang rmang gan khang du/ rje dus mkhyen sngon gyi gnas su sdigs mdzub mdzad pa mthong bas nam mkha' 'od kyi skye ba gsal bar dran/ sngon gzigs pa'i grub chen brgyad cu yang mi gsal tsam du gzigs te de'i tshul gsungs pas dad par mdzad/ dgung lo gsum pa nas skye bo'i tshogs la chos gsung ba dang*/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes du ma gsungs pas gzhan gyi log rtog bsal/ de lta bus rtogs ldan rin po che'i sku skyer mchog dman kun yid ches te/

dgung lo drug pa la mkhas grub dar rgyal bas gdan 'dren la byon/ mnal lam brtags pas kyang seng ge'i phru gu shin tu legs pa zhig lha'i bus phyag tu gtad par rmis/ mjal ba tsam gyis yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod ste gus pas spyan drangs/ lam bye lung gi chu mdor chu ches pa'i rab 'khor nas nas dpon slob mang po chu dbus su lhung ba na/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma nam mkhar gzigs pa'i mdo la bde bar thon/ mtshur phu dang gnas nang du byon/ dge slong dar ma tshul khrims la nam mkha' 'od kyi skyes rabs rgyas pa gsungs/ chos rje dang mjal tsam nas rje nam mkha' la dal bus gshegs pa zhig gis bu bstan par bya yis ltos shig gsungs te gar mdzad nas skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ sprul pa du ma spro ba gzigs pas nyid kyang bzod med du gar du ma mdzad cing*/ dpal rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// rje mkhyen pas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab cing sems nyid sgrib bral du gzigs/ dgung lo bdun pa la rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang mtshe smad du mjal/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ byang chub tu thugs bskyed/ dbang gyis smin par mdzad de/ phyag chen chos drug gi khrid bskyangs/ bde chen du mkhan chen rin po che don grub dpal ba dang*/ slob dpon chos rje rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan ye shes dpal zhes gsol/ mkhan chen rin po che la kā ri kā sogs chos phran 'ga' zhig gsan/ chos rje g.yung ston pa la'ang sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub zhus/ rje ri khrod pa la rgyud 'bum dang*/ mdo mang phal che ba'i lung dang dbang rjes gnang mang du gsan/ khyad par du yang bka' brgyud kyi man ngag zab cing rgya che ba phal che ba la nan tan du mdzad/ gnas nang du rje na rim bzhi po phyag na bum ba bsnams pa mtha'i bdud rtsi dbus mar bsdus nas dbang rim pa gsum re mos su bskur te/

sku drug dbang drug thig le drug/ sbyor drug gsang ba ye shes mdzod// ces gsung pa gzigs/ bla mas dbu la 'tshams pa'i cod pan dmar po bcings pa na/ rje dus mkhyen dang ḍā ki ma bdun gyis shis pa brjod cing*/ gur gum dang mu tig bsres pa'i char 'bebs par gzigs/ lha sar jo bo rin po che mjal ba'i tshe/ rje rang byung rdo rje man shel dag pa'i sku can du gyur par gzigs/ yang gnas nang du chos rje nyid grub thob mang po'i dbus na bzhugs pas de kho na nyid bstan/ g.yam bzang pa bsod nams 'od la'ang khrid kha mang zhig gsan zhing sku mtshams dam par mdzad nas bsgoms pas/ gnas nang gi sgom chen thams cad kyi spyod lam ma lus pa mngon du gzigs te so sor tshar gcod pa dang*/ rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal ta gnang bas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur/ de nas dgung lo bco brgyad la bab pa lug gi lo la mkhan chen rin po che don grub dpal ba dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rdo rje/ gsang ston gzhon nu dpal ba dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i nub mo mnal lam du nam mkha' la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhi shar ba dang*/ rang nyid chos gos gsum gyis g.yogs te lha mi du ma chos kyis tshims par byas pa'i ltas khyad par ba byung*/ bde ba can pa slob dpon 'jam rin la byams chos lnga dang*/ tshad ma rnam nges/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa rnams gsan/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i zhal slob mkhan chen kun dga' 'od zer la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs dbang bskur du ma gsan zhing*/ byang gi 'dam dang sog la brgyud de re shod gyi bar du phebs/ re rgyab tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje nyid kyis cod pan lan dgur dbu la bcings par gzigs pa dang*/ yor rgyangs su phyag gis spyi bor byug cing ljags mchil btab pas gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la reg pa ltar gyur te rten 'brel gyi sgo du ma gzigs/

byang phyogs pho rang la'i rgyud du zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol can gyi bla ma las shes rab bzhi sbyor gyi man ngag gsan/ yang thang lha'i rgyud du bla ma rta mchog gi khri la bzhugs pas kyang na bzas g.yogs te bu zhes dgyes par mdzad cing lung bstan par gzigs/ yul de dag tu 'khod pa'i skya ser kun gyi 'bul ba mang du byung ba bsnams te/ gnas nang du chos dang mthun pa'i khrims dang dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen du gnang*/ rje ri khrod pa bde bar gshegs rjes grā pa dmu rgod rnams la thugs skyo nas gdan sa bla ma bsod nams 'bum la gtad nas gnas nang gi rgyab ri sog ri khrod kho nar bzhugs/ mkhan chen 'od zer rgya mtsho la snying thig gi skor cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ slob dpon 'od zer dpal la snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'grel dang gter kha gong 'og gi bka' lung phal che ba zhus shing*/ nyin mtshan du g.yel ba med par rgyud gzhung gzigs rtog dang gtso bor thugs dam ting nge 'dzin kho na la mi g.yel bar mdzad/ yang gnas nang gi rtser dben pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i sku nyi ma ltar 'bar bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun sdigs mdzub kyis rtse zhing*/ ma shar nyi ma gang du nub par 'gyur// mi g.yo sdigs mdzub 'di ni gar byed de// ye shes nyi bdun gsang ba'i rol mo dang*// lha mo'i 'og pags nor bu'i rang bzhin ltos// zhes gsungs pa gsan/ slar yang re shod du phebs ste chos rje'i drung nas gsang ba mchog gi byin rlabs gsan pas rdo rje'i sems la nges pa thob/ mtshur phur spos kyi glang chen la bzhuḍa pa'i bla ma'i sku 'od zer rnam par bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo ston pa gzigs te/ kun nas 'gag med nam mkha'i sgo// gang du'ang ma bcang ma phye ba// mi shes rang gis rnam par bcad// shes pa rnam par grol ba nyid// 'on kyang 'gog snang de lta na// sgo glegs mnyam par bzhag pa nyid// sus kyang bsdam dgrol med pa la//

khyod g.yengs ma byas tsam gyis so// phyi dang nang dang bar dag las// ji ltar 'dod 'di byung song gnas// brtag kyang med do de bas na/ 'od 'di stong nyid 'od po che// 'di ji lta ba de lta bur// chos rnams thams cad sman par ltos// ting nge 'dzinagyi rgyal po mchog/ 'di ni rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo// zhes gsungs pa gsan/ rtsod pa cung zhig byung bas/ kye ma chos dang mi mthun pa'i// chos pa'i gzugs kyis ci zhig bya// zhes byang chub lam glu gsungs nas dpon slob bcu tsam zhig dbur stod nas lam phyung nyang po rgyab mdar rje dus mkhyen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can gyis shel gyi za ma tog gnang ste/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi sku gdung zung zhig ces bstsal ba gzigs/ rim gyis kong po'i yul khams thams cad du byon/ gnas ci rigs par dben pa mdzad/ 'o thang du zhing dang sku mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma las kun sbyor sum grol gyi man ngag gsan/ sum mkhar phu'i dben pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i sku'i bkod pa dga' ldan na bzhugs pa rgyal ba dri ma med pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bstan pa dang*/ khyad par tsā ri gsar ma'i byin legs su yun ring du bzhugs shing*/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du ba yo ri dgon dang bcas pa'i bdag rkyen kyang mdzad/ yang chos rje'i drung du dpal nā ro chos drug gi man ngag sogs rgya cher zhus shing*/ dbu ma rtog ge 'bar ba sogs dbu ma'i gzhung rnams kyang gsan/ tsā ri ma chen gyi brag dkar mor yang lo gsum bzhugs shing brag logs la zhabs rjes gsal bar yod/ ri sked dang phan tshun 'phur nas nyi ma la bzhugs par grags/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkod pa du ma gzigs shing rdo rje'i glu gsan/ stag ma phu dang lkog 'phrang la sogs par yun rin du bzhugs/ stag ma phur 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dri med du bzhugs pa gzigs shing*/

zab mo'i don gyi dri lan mdzad pa mnal lam du snang*/ de nyid du oḍ+yan du khrid de 'khor lo'i 'du ba las rdo rje theg pa'i nges pa bstsal/ lhun grub steng du dpal gyi ri'i bkod pa gzigs/ gnas chen tsā rir chos rje rin po ches yid bzhin gyi nor bu bdun stsal te gsang ba'i lag khrid gnang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa'i bla gos dang*/ ḍom+bhi pa'i rdor dril gtad de 'khor lo lam srang gi sgo phye/ rgya mtsho sgang du rin po che'i bang mdzod du ma byin te man ngag so gsum pa bstan/ shel gyi pi waṃ reg pa tsam gyis snyan pa'i sgra 'byung ba las mi shigs rgyan drug gi chos sgra gsan/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje gshegs pa'i tshe ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mang po gzigs nas gdung dbyangs mdzad/ khyad par ri bo chen po dngos grub 'dzin du rgyal ba nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i skur bzhugs pa las lus sems 'chi med kyi nges pa rnyed pa sogs bshes gnyen byin brlabs kyi rnam thar brjod kyis mi lang ba mnga'/ de dag gi skabs su yi dam gyi zhal gzigs tshul yang*/ 'khrungs nas cher ma lon par gnam gyi na 'gor mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi gzigs te gnad kyi me long gsungs/ de nas mi ring bar spyan ras gzigs gsal bar gzigs te de kho na ltar gzhan la sgom bzlas gsung ba las tshig thugs la bzung ma dgos/ nam skrag pa na sgrol ma byon te dbugs 'byin/ gnas nang du rje ri khrod pa las bde mchog gi dbang gsan tshe bde mchog gi lha tshogs ji lta bar gzigs/ yang ut+pal la bzhugs pa'i sgrol ma mu tig gi rgyan can dang*/ rta mchog gser gyi rdo rje nam mkhar gsor zhing bzhad pa'i sgras sa g.yo ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma dang*/ bde mchog dkar po shel bum 'dzin pa dang*/ dmar po drug cu rtsa gnyis pa kun nas chags pa dang*/ dgyes rdor ser po zhal phyag mtha' yas pa sogs gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs gser mdog mnyam pa'i stabs can phyag gnyis pa yum dkar mo can gzigs shing*/

bde ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'dzin// rgyal ba rgya mtsho skyed pa'i yab// rigs drug 'khor los sgyur ba'i sku// rnam dag ye shes rol pa che// zhes pa'i sgra gsan/ phug mo cher rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma yab sngo sangs phyag gnyis pas 'khyud pa snying po'i dpa' bo bzhi/ gzhan dpa' bo nyer bzhi/ dpa' mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i 'khor yang dag pas bskor ba mthong ste/ skad cig gcig gis de dag med par/ dpal ldan dbang po'i blo btsun mo du mar bcas pa snang bas rdo rje mdud 'grol chags chen gyi bseb lam bstan pas thugs rab tu rangs par gyur/ bde chen du bdag med ma dkar mo lha mo bco lnga la sogs pas gar bsgyur zhing*/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo rab tu dag /zhes sgrog pa gsan/ gnas nang du dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sku nam mkha' khyab pa yud tsam gzigs/ de nyid du sher phyin dkar mo la phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bstod pa dang*/ mod de nyid la dam pa'i sku che chung sna tshogs pas 'jig rten khyab cing man ngag gi gsang du ma gsan/ snang mtha' yum dang slob dpon pad+ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros mchod pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la bsdu ba'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa/ dpal sdings su mkha' spyod dkar dmar rigs drug nam mkhar brtse ba dang*/ gnas nang du dga' ldan gyi gnas dang byams mgon gyi zhal gzigs/ de nyid du sangs rgyas kun gzigs chos 'chad can dang*/ de'i zhing mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa zhing dang bcas pa gzigs shing de dag gi zhing sbyong dang smon lam mdzad/ de la sogs pa yi dam zhal mthong gi rnam par thar pa nam mkha'i mthas gzhal bar mi nus so// nyer dgu pa sa rta la stag rtse rnam rgyal gyi dgon sa yon bdag rnams kyis phul nas dgon pa btab/ dge 'dun yang brgya phrag gnyis tsam byung*/ so brgyad pa me yos la rje de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo bzhi bzhes pa stag rtser spyan drangs chos dang zang zing gis mchod de rje des kyang yongs 'dzin gcig pu par bkur/

so bdun pa shing stag la dga' ldan ma mo btab/ spyir sgom chen pa gtsang ma sum brgya las mi nyung ba rnams dbyar dgun la zla ba gsum re mtshams gcod cing khrid kyi phrin las khor yug tu mdzad pas/ rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bgrang ba las 'das pa byung*/ kong ral gsum la chos rgya dkar po lo du ma mdzad/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpon slob lhan cig par dbus su byon te mtshur phu la sogs par phrin las rgya chen mdzad/ mtshur phu'i seng ge sgo mdun du chos drug gsungs shing*/ sog dbon rig ral sogs smin par mdzad/ slar kong por phrin las bskyangs shing chos gsung ba na rgyang grags gnyis tsam nas gsung mnyam par thos skad de/ sngon rje grags pa seng ge gsung mi bzang bas/ skye ba phyi ma la skad kyi rten 'brel sgrig gsung nas dung dkar bzang ba zhig btsal te rje rang byung rdo rje la phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis rje mkha' spyod pa tshangs pa'i gsung lta bur yod par snang*/ dung 'di la phyis gan nas gser ljang brdungs kyi gshog pa phul te rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung dang lhan cig gan+dho la'i mchod rdzas la da lta'ang yod do// mi ma yin gdug pa can mang po dge bsnyen la bkod/ khrid yig nyams mgur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa 'di rnams ni bstan pa la mdzad pa shin tu

che'o/ /gtso bor ma ra steng sogs dben pa kho na bsten par mdzad/ gzhan yang gnyid 'od gsal du tshud cing rmi lam sgyu lus su dag pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs snang phran tshegs kyi rim pa'ang*/ gnas nang du gser gyi ra bas bskor ba'i pho brang du/ rgyal po yon tan rmad byung gi bu gzhon nur gyur pas gser ri'i rtser shel gyi mchod rten la bskor ba na/ rin chen bdun gyis dbang bskur zhing shel gyi mchod rten sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab pa dang*/ gser g.yu 'ba' zhig gi ri bo'i phug rnams su grub pa'i slob dpon bsten pa dang*/ gzi brjid blo gros dang*/ mun pa rnam sel dang*/ blo gros rnam nges dang*/ grags pa'i cod pan dang*/ seng ge bstan pa dang*/ lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ nyi zla brtsegs pa dang*/ nam mkha'i tog dang*/ ye shes dbang po dang*/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang*/ yid bzhin kun 'byung zhes bya ba'i sku'i cha byad sna tshogs pa rnams kyis man ngag bstan pa dang*/ mchog tu mdzes pa'i pun+da rī las sidha rak+ṣi'i man ngag rnyed pa dang*/ lha'i tshogs du mas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i yo byad rgyal chen bzhis 'dzin pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i tog nor bu nyi ma ltar 'bar ba can las ba dan dkar po nam mkha' khyab par spro ba phyag gis 'dzin pa dang*/ pad+ma rā ga'i cang te rang sgra 'byung ba 'dzin pas gar byed pa gzigs pa dang*/ ḍā ki ma'i tshogs kyis ka pā la bdud rtsi can phul bas bde ba chen po'i mthu brtas par gyur ba dang*/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi sras mo bud med mdzes ma mang pos bskor bas dgyes pa bskyed cing de'i rkyen gyis yid 'ong bde ldan gyi bkod pa dran pa ste/ de rnams gnas nang kho na yin zhing*/ bre pong du dung ltar dkar ba'i gzhon nus g.yu'i bum chen rin po ches bkang ba phul ba dang*/ gnas nang du rin po che'i gur dang khri'i bkod pa mdzes par mngon par rol ba'i tshul dang*/

lus thams cad g.yu 'od 'bar bas bar med du brgyan pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis zab mo'i don gyi glu dang gar byas pas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung du 'phel ba dang*/ gnas nang ri rtser nam mkha' rten med par bzhugs te/ phyag g.yas kyi mthil nyi ma las lhag pa'i 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa dang*/ tsā rir gser gyi khang par gser gyi rnga bo che bdun bsgrigs su snang ba'i gcig brdungs bas kun las sgra byung ste/ zab cing rgya chen nam mkha'i rnga bo che// nam mkha'i yid can su zhig rdung bar rtog/ ma brdungs par yang mkha' khyab chos kyi sgra// mi chung mi zad nam mkha' mnyam par grags// phyi dang nang gzhan dbye ba med pa'i sgra// dbyangs gsal rdo rje gser gyi rnga chen 'di// byung gnas 'jig pa med cing 'gyur bas dben// 'di ni lhun grub rtag dngos yid bzhin bde// zhes grag pa gsan/ ri'i tshad tsam gyi skyes bu rta mchog la gnas pas dpag tshad tsam gyi gser gyi ral gri gdengs pas rnga bo che lta bu'i sgra grags par gzigs/ rnal 'byor ma dar yol zhig gis 'dul ba gsung ba gsan/ tsā ri pad phug tu rin po che'i mchod rten sgo phye ba can gyi nang du byon pas bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa gzigs/ so la steng du oḍ+yan gyi bkod pa ri brag me tog dang mchod rten gyis gang bar dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lang long du gzigs shing man ngag gi gnad kyis tshim/ g.yu mtshor nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma kha dog sna tshogs pa mngon par dga' bar 'khor lo 'du ba la 'gro'o zhes zer zhing khyed cag kyang 'dong ngo zer ba na/ kho bo mi 'gro ste 'khor lo 'du ba 'di nyid du 'byung ngo*// 'o na 'khor lo bdun gyi ting nge 'dzin ston zhig zer ba na skad cig de nyid du rnam 'phrul dran rdzogs su bkod pas rab tu tshim/ gnas nang du pad+ma rā ga'i me tog rgyangs grags tsam gyis khebs par ting nge 'dzin mdzad pa na nam mkha' thams cad nyi zla spel mas gang ba las/

dngul gyi me tog gi char reg na bde ba 'bab cing lha'i bu mo mtha' yas pas/ rdo rje'i glu blangs pa las zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i nges pa rnyed/ so la steng du glang po che shin tu che ba'i ro grogs zhig dang gnyis kyi bshus pa las sha rus thams cad ring bsrel 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/ de dag yi ge'i rnam par gyur nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs shing lding ba dang rgyal ba'i gdung mang du 'phro bar gzigs/ tsā rir shel gyi ral gri 'doms gang ba'i rtse la me 'bar zhing*/ so las 'ja' tshon 'byung ba/ yu ba las bdud rtsi 'bab pa zhig rnyed de/ des rang lus grangs med du bsil bas ral gri dang mnyam pa'i lus rdzogs pa de rnyed du snang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur snang ba na sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pas gṛ ha de ba nas zhugs te dza lan dhar nas byung zhing slar yang hi ma la ya dang ra me shwa ra'i gnas sogs nas zhugs cing chos kyi 'khor lor rab tu brtan pa la sogs pa'i rol pa du ma mdzad do// de ltar gsang sgron rnam bkod las 'byung ba'i gzigs snang rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i don 'grel nyung ngu zhig kyang rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum du bzhugs so/ gzhan yang rnam thar re mig ma sogs nas 'byung ba skabs shig na/ mchod rten gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dang dri lan mdzad pa*/ tsā rir lam+bikā mu kha gzigs shing de'i pho brang du bzhugs pa/ dpal pad+ma badz+ra las gdan sa rgyal 'dzin du rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul gzigs pa/ gtso bor gnas brtan bcu drug bzhugs khri'i bkod pa sna tshogs can gzigs pa/ de nyid du bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gzigs pa/ lhun grub steng du yul rigs rgya chen khyab pa'i khang bzang du 'gro ba mang po la dbang bskur ba/ sgam por ḍom+bi pa gzigs pa/ byang du bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan pa/

tsā ri pash+tsa tar dur khrod rngam pa sgra sgrogs gzigs shing*/ lha'i yul du 'khrungs pa dran pa/ lkog 'phrang gi rir lho brag grub pa'i gnas kyi bkod pa bum chen ltar gzigs pa/ rgyal gyi ri bor ma ṇi bhaṃ ga la gzigs pa/ sum mkhar dga' ldan du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa/ tsā ri trar 'jam dpal dkar po yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor gzigs pa/ de dang nye bar byang sham+bha la'i bkod pa gzigs pa/ mtshur phur phyag rdor dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa rnams te/ de las ri bo ma ṇi bhaṃ ga la gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid kyi gsung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ yang re zhig gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam 'khrul pa la dran pa'i shes pa skyes te/ e ma 'di ni rmi lam mo/ /rang las gzhan du med pa'i gnas kyi bkod pa dag lta'o snyam nas/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'phur zhing song ba las/ ri bo ma ṇi bhaṃ ga la mthong bar byas/ 'dod pa'i don cung zad kyang thob ste 'ongs pa na/ ras kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gos lhab lhub dang*/ me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i bu mo bdun zhig lam na 'khod de/ kye rnal 'byor pa cung zad bzhes shig ces zer ro/ /'di ni dpag bsam shing gi snye ma'o/ /zhes shing thog byin zhing*/ me tog gi phreng bas lus brgyan te mgu bar byas nas glu blangs pa/ 'o na dga' 'o bde 'o rnal 'byor mchog/ de ring sngon gyi nyer spyod dran// dur khrod chen po dpal gyi nags// slob dpon chen po sūr+ya pa// dngos grub chen po nyi ma pa// dran nam shes sam rnal 'byor mchog/ yang na rnal 'byor rang yul zung*// yang na sgyu rtsal cho ga ston// yang na gnas kyi bkod pa brjod// gzhan du 'gro ba'i go skabs med// ces so// de'i tshe cung zad bsams te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba 'di rang las gzhan ma yin te/ 'on kyang sgyu rtsal gyis zil gyis mnan na nus mod kyi/

ḍā ki'i rigs la gya tshoms su brgal bar mi bya/ glu len bya'o zhes bsam nas/ rang 'dra ba gnyis g.yas g.yon du bkod de ram 'degs su stsal nas smras pa/ e ma/ rang snang ḍā ki'i tshogs rnams dang bas gson/ /rnal 'byor mkha' spyod dbang po gar yang phyin/ /rdzu 'phrul yid kyi lus 'dis gang yang brtol/ phyogs bcu kun 'gro'i lam yang dgag mi nus/ /rnal 'byor rang yul 'dzin du mi lus yod/ /sgyu rtsal cho ga bstan pa khyed la bzang*/ /sngon gyi nyer spyod dran yang ci zhig bya/ /chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid ma mthong ngam/ /byang phyogs brda yi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod pa/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i bkod pa los te shes/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i shar nas bltas tsam na/ /glang chen rab brtan gser gyis brgyan pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i lho nas bltas tsam na/ /rta mchog sprin shugs chas su bcug pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i nub nas bltas tsam na/ /rab mdzes rma bya gar la chas pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i byang nas bltas tsam na/ /bya mchog shang shang glu gar bsgyur ba 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i stod du bltas tsam na/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten sgo mang bkod pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i nang du bltas tsam na/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i bkod pa bkram pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i steng du bltas tsam na/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i gdugs mdzes phub pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i mtha' mar bltas tsam na/ /phyogs skyong dbang po du mas 'dud pa 'dra/ /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i 'og tu bltas tsam na/ /bai ḍūr dag pa'i me long phyis pa 'dra/ /dgyes par mdzod cig rigs ldan ḍā ki'i tshogs/ /yang dag ye shes snying po grub par smon/ /zhes pa la de dag mgu ste phyag byas nas smras pa/ e ma mkha' spyod rnal 'byor mchog /ri bo bhaṃ ga'i rnam bzhag mtshar/ /nged cag gnas gsum ḍā' ki ma/ /rdo rje lus kyi ri bo shes/ /'gyur med sems kyi ri bo dang*/ /don dam mchog gi ri bo shes/

/ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gnas/ /rdo rje glu yi gsang mdzod lags/ /rnam pa kun tu mi 'bral ba/ /mched lcam dam tshig srog shing laḍa/ / yang dag bkod pa'i gser gyi rir/ /dus btab 'gyur ba med pa lags/ /zhes sogs mang zhig smras/ myos byed blud pa'i mod la gnyid sad de bsams pas/ phal cher dran pa las de yang rim gyis yal bar gyur te/ 'di dag nyung shas tsam dal las su bgyis pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ yang rje mkha' spyod pa nyid kyi gzigs snang re'u mig tu bkod pa 'phro can zhig las/ dbang gi phug tu sprin gyi phung po'i dbus su/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ sa ra ha rnams tho brtsegs su snang zhing rang nyid la thim par snang ba/ tsā rir dgra bcom pa rasmi bi ma las rjes su bzung zhing gdams pa byin pa/ dgon sar du dharma ma ti btsun mo dang bcas pa mthong ba/ de nyid du zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i puṇ+ya rat+na mthong ba/ ye gong du pad+ma 'byung gnas mthong ba/ stag khrom du dpal pradz+nya bha dra mkha' 'gro du mas bskor ba snang ba/ bkra shis dgra bcom pa rasmi bi ma la dkar po snang ba'i gos dang ldan pas gdams pa dang dris lan mang du mdzad/ de nyid du seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun mi la mkha' 'gro du ma'i 'khor dang bcas te gdams pa cung zad glur blangs pa mthong zhing thos pa/ de nyid du mnga' bdag ḍom+bhi pa btsun mo dang bcas pa mthong ba/ de nyid du shin tu dkar ba'i mchod rten 'dzin pa'i dam pa sangs rgyas snang ba/ de nyid du sa ra ha gtso 'khor gsum gsal ba/ der grub thob tshem bu pas tshigs su bcad pa zhig bka' stsal zhing gdams pa/ de nyid du dpal bir+wa pa btsun mo dang bcas pa mthong ba/ de nyid du sangs rgyas bud+dha kīr+t+ti dang pun+ye badz+ra mthong ba/ der rdo rje 'chang dang dpal dhar+m+ma kīr+t+ti (dus gsum mkhyen pa mchan ) snang ba/ der rgyal ba badz+ra shrī la rma bya du mas mchod pa mthong ba/

pad phug tu chu skyes la gnas pa'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha ba mthong ba/ mngon pa la dga' bas chos kyi rje rat+na shrī dz+nyā na la dpa' bo du mas bskor ba gsal ba/ dgon gsar du dpal dz+nyā na sid+dhi gtso 'khor gsum gyi dris lan du ma mdzad pa gzigs pa rnams byung zhing*/ yang khrums zla'i tshes bco brgyad kyi tho rangs/ ri ngos mchog tu mdzes pa zhig na/ shel gyi mchod rten che zhing dpe med pa'i bkod pa can bcu gsum/ mu tig gdugs bla na med pa sum brtsegs dang*/ bdun brtsegs kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i bar par gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha'i dra bas nye bar brgyan pa dpag bsam gyi ljon pa dang*/ me tog skyed tshal/ bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu dang*/ bya tshogs yid du 'ong ba du mas rab tu bkra bar byas pa'i dbus kyi mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang rin po che'i khri ha cang mtho ba ma yin pa la/ rje btsun rin po che sku'i cha lugs ji lta bas bzhugs pa'i mdun na/ ldong ros kyi mdog lta bu dmar ser shin tu rgyas shing smin pa'i shing 'bras kyis gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod 'dzin zhing gus pas bdag nyid 'dug par mthong ste/ de'i tshe mgon po'i phyag g.yas kyi theb srin gyis/ shing 'bras gsum zhig bsnams te gsungs pa// mi dge dge dang de bzhin gnyis med pa// 'khor ba de 'das de bzhin mnyam pa nyid// rtog pa rtog bral yang dag de kho na// dgyes pa dam pa'i dgyes dang lhan cig skyes// 'di dang 'di dag zhes pa rnam grangs kyi// rnam pa rab gnas dbyer med ngo bo nyid// gang 'di'i mngar ba yid 'ong ro brgya'i gtso// rang la gnas pa rang gis myong bya kye// zhes pa la gus pas btud de yang dag par blangs nas myangs pa las ches shin tu mngar ba tshad med pa mthong ste/ e ma ho/ /dge mi dge 'das 'khor mi rtog rnams ji ltar bzhi pa gsum pa dang sbyar/ shin tu tshim pa skyed pa'i ro 'di ni de ring las bdag gis gzhar yang ma mthong na ji ltar rang la gnas pa zhes gsungs snyam du gyur pa las/

mgon po 'dzum pa mdzad pa mthong ngo*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ yang smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs yid rlung shin tu dngas ba'i rmi lam gyi snang bar shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i snang ba snang ba dag mdor bsdus te brjod pa/ yid 'ong dzam bu chu gser bkod pa'i zhing*/ /mthong dang dran thos dga' bde mchog sbyin byed/ /lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i dpal stong 'bar/ /nor bu rin chen bye bas rnam par bkra/ / gser gyi mtsho skyes 'dab rgyas dri zhim ldan/ /aṇ+ḍa snyil mdog dpag yas pad+ma'i mtsho/ / gser ri'i phreng ba bye ru'i sdong pos brgyan/ /ri rtser 'dab stong ldan pa'i pad+mo rgyas/ /lta shing yongs 'du'i phreng mdzes me tog dang*/ /'bras bu'i bcud ldan dri bzang kun tu 'phro/ / dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon ldan pad+mo'i dbus/ /rin chen rang bzhin gzhal med khang bzang bkod/ /rab mchog mtshan nyid thams cad rab tu rdzogs/ /phyi dang nang med gzhal 'od phreng ba 'khrigs/ /mkha' dbus 'od stong ldan pa'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /so grangs bsil zer ldan pa'i phreng mdzes gsal/ /rin chen grong khyer grong brdal bkod pa can/ /dal gyis mngon par 'gro ba gser ri'i phreng*/ /mkha' la rang dbang rgyu ba'i mdzes pa dang*/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin mang rnam par brdal/ /khang bzang rnam par rgyal mtshungs bye ba snyed/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu mngon par bkram/ /yid 'ong skyed tshal rdzing bu'i phreng mdzes dang*/ /bdud rtsi'i chu klung bsam yas bkod pa 'phags/ /mi dang lha klu lha min gnod sbyin dbang*/ /dri za nam mkha' lding sogs rab mdzes ldan/ /rin chen rgyan chas lhag par mdzes byas pa/ /du mas phyag 'tshal mchod cing mngon par bstod/ /lang long me tog char mang bde byed dang*/ /dar dir sil snyan bstod pa'i sgra yid 'ong*/ /mthong ngam dran pa yis kyang tshim byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes thugs rje'i mthu las grub//

de lta bu'i bkod pa mchog gis kun tu brgyan pa'i zhing gi dbus/ gser gyi pho brang khang pa brtsegs pa du ma'i dkyil rgya che zhing mtho la mdzes pa mtha' yas pas mngon par 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang gser gyi rgyal mtshan bye ba stong gis brgyan pa'i rtser/ gser gyi gdugs mu tig gi dra bas rnam par g.yogs pa/ nor bu rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i tog nyi ma stong gi 'od las lhag par 'od gsal bas mtshan pa phub pa/ bar snang nas lha'i bu dang bu mo du mas mchod par byed pa/ pho brang gi thog rim pa nyer bzhi pa'i dbus rin po che'i khri mchog tu mdzes pa la/ mgon po nam mkha' dri ma med pa/ sku byad dang cha lugs kyi rnam par 'gyur ba thos pa brgyud pa bas tshad med par 'phags pa mngon sum du bzhugs par mthong ste/ 'od bzang gser gyi dpyad ldan lha mi'i dar/ /'bar ba'i mtshams sprin lta bus rab g.yogs pas/ /kha ri 'char ka'i 'od kyis gos 'dra'i sku/ /mtshan dpe bye ba stong gi mdzes pas mdzes/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya phyag rgya'i tog /rab bcings 'dzum rlabs 'od dkar 'khyil pa'i zhal/ /ka la paṅki tshangs dbyangs dri za'i glu/ /bye bas bsgrun med zab rgyas rnam par spro/ /ye shes thuḍa rje'i stobs kyis mngon 'phaḍa pa/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho rnam par bkod pa'i dbus/ /ri chos dpal 'byor 'byor pa kun gyi gtso/ /chos kyi kun dga'i dga' ston 'gyed par brtson/ /mgon po dpa' chen kun gyi g.yas dang g.yon/ /rab mchog rgyal sras pad mo 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa sel byed bcom ldan 'das// rgyal ba kun skyed gus btud ngo mtshar ldan// de lta bu'i nye logs mi dman pa'i khri'i bkod pa la bdag nyid kyang bde bar 'dug pa mthong ste 'di lta bu dag bsams par gyur to// e ma ho/ /lha'i gnas yongs su dga' ldan na lha'i bu nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i tshul gyis mngon par bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid chen po gang*/

sngon 'phags pa'i yul gyi skye bo dang rjes su mthun pa'i sku ji lta bas 'dir rgyal ba'i rgya mtsho la chos ston par mdzad pa ni ches ya mtshan no/ /'di lta bu'i zhal bde blag tu mthong ba bdag kyang skal par rab tu gyur pa'o/ /de bas na mthong bar dka' ba mthong ba'i tshe sgrim ste brtag par bya'o zhes sku'i cha lugs la zhib tu brtags te ji lta ji ltar btags pa de ltar de ltar dga' ba dang*/ gus pa dang dad pa tshad med pa skyes par gyur to// de'i tshe bka' stsal pa/ kyai rigs ldan/ e waṃ shrī bya ba rtogs par gyur tam zhes so/ / de'i tshe 'di ni 'di lta bu'o zhes bya ba'i yid la nges pa med bzhin du/ 'di skad ces brjod cing gsol to/ /mkhyen ldan mgon po rmad byung lha yi lha/ /thos sam dran pa yis kyang bder byed pa/ /khyod ni bskal pa bye bar mthong dka' ste/ /'di mthong bdag gi bsod nams snying por gyur/ /phyi dang lus sogs gzhi dang lta sogs dang*/ /myug sogs 'byung dang de bzhin chos la sogs/ /sgra don kun 'gro'i nges pa bdag 'tshal te/ /'di la the tshom 'jug pa ma dmigs so/ /'on kyang 'di na bstan dka' phal che ba/ /de lugs bdag la gsal mdzod grub pa dang*/ /mi shigs snying po brtag pa mi dbang gis/ /nges pas tshim pa rgya chen bskyed du gsol/ /zhes pa la dgyes pa bskyed de bka' stsal pa/ /legs so skal ldan dri med dpal ye shes/ /phal cher gyur pa mchog gi theg don mthun/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sgo mang 'byed sde mig /ji ltar mos don rab bsgrub bla na med/ /'khor 'das sna tshogs snang yang snang bzhin stong*/ /med bzhin du yang kun snang don dam pa/ /zab mo sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul mchog /mnyam nyid rang grol rgyal ba dgongs pa'i bcud/ /yod med gnyis gnyis min 'dzin rnam spangs pa/ /mtha' bral gnyis med gnyis brjod de bzhin nyid/ / chos rnams kun gyi yang dag gsang chen don/

/'di las gzhan du su zhig don dam stsal/ / zhes bka' stsal ba'i mod la/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa rigs kyi khyab bdag tu grub par mthong ste/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon par grub pa dang thabs gcig pas/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi sgo 'byed par byed pa'i phrin las la gnas par mthong ngo*// de'i tshe shar phyogs nas glog gi 'od bskal pa'i me ltar mchog tu 'od gsal bas 'jig rten mtha' dag khyab par gyur pa las/ sgo'i srung ma bcom ldan 'das dag gis hūm̐ zhes sgra tshad med par sgrogs pa 'brug stong ldir ba ltar gyur cing*/ sa chen po g.yo ba sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du mas sems cung zad skrag cing nyam nga bar gyur pa na/ 'di ni mgon po mchog gi thugs rje'i 'jug pa rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa'o/ /zhes dran pa brtan par bskyed de gnas pa las/ 'dod pa'i don ji lta ba ster bar byed pa/ rdo rje gsang ba chen po'i ye shes dpe las rnam par 'das pa'i de kho na nyid kyi rim pa thob ste/ sems rangs pa tshad med pa thob par gyur to// slar sku snga ma ji lta bar bsgyur te bka' stsal pa/ byis pa mtshan dga' 'dab brgya ldan pa'i gnyen/ /zad byed du mthong bdud rtsi bsil zer byed/ /kha me rnams kyi 'bar byed gdung byed bzhin/ /nyams byed sreg byed phung byed mthar byed nyid/ /skal ldan lha yi bde mchog mya ngan med/ /dka' ba'i 'bad bral phral du mngon byed pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyi gsang ba dam pa'i gsang*/ /khyod la deng 'dir gsal bar rab bstan to/ /zhes sogs mang zhig thos pa'i mod la 'khrul pa'i gnyid sad de bsams pa las phal cher dran zhing dad pa dang spro ba tshad las 'das pa yang thob bo/ /zhes dang*/ lo yi rgyal po lug gi lo yi dus/ /zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes bcu bzhi la/ /tho rangs dus kyi rmi lam snang ba la/

/dpal ldan bla ma chos rje rang byung ba/ /pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng na rab bzhugs shing*/ /rin chen dra ba sprin gyis spras pa'i dbus/ /klu sgrub sa ra ha la sogs pa yi/ /grub chen du mas rab tu bskor ba mthong*/ /dpal ldan bla mas bdag la 'di skad gsungs/ /chos don rnam dag chos kyi sprin/ /grub chen dra ba pad+ma'i dbus/ /grub chen rgya mtsho dang bcas pa/ /mthong ste smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /de bas dri med dpal ldan khyod/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa phyi nang med/ /nang na gnas so rigs kyi bu/ /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang*/ /chos dbyings gcig la 'dus so bu/ /chos dbyings gcig kyang chos sgo ni/ /bye ba dpag med yin no bu/ /de bas chos dbyings nyid rtogs na/ /chos sgo dpag med rtogs gyur bu/ /de phyir dri med dpal ldan khyod/ /chos nyid rtogs pa'i skyes bu yin/ /phyin chad chos sgo dpag med la/ /blta dang bsam dang 'chad la dbang*/ /rang byung rdo rjes bshad do gyis/ /skal ldan slob ma'i rna bar sgrogs/ /phyogs med rgyal khams thams cad du/ /rtsol med 'gro don dpag med 'byung*/ /zhes pa rdo rje'i tshigs gcig lhag pa yi/ /lnga yis ston te dpal ldan bla ma rnams/ /dbyer med rnal 'byor dri med dpal ldan khyod/ / phyogs med 'gro don dpag med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gsungs te rang gi lus la thim pa snyam/ /zhes dang*/ gnas nang 'dug tshe 'khrul pa'i rmi lam na/ /ri ngos rab tu gzar zhing mtho ba'i ngos/ /bdag gis gtsos byas mi tshogs dpag med 'dug /'og na mtsho chen rlabs kyi phreng ba can/ /shin tu 'jigs pas rab tu bskor ba mthong*/ /mi tshogs de dag sgrol bar sems pa la/ /brtan dang g.yo bas bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /skye 'gag gnas bral rmi lam sgyu ma tsam/ /bden par ma grub stong nyid rang bzhin du/ /nyams la shar bas skad cig de nyid la/ /mtsho de'i dkyil du rang nyid kyis phyin pas/

/pad+ma 'dab brgyad byi ru'i mdangs ldan pa/ /ge sar phreng ba rab tu g.yo ba'i dbus/ /ze'u 'bru'i steng na gsung gi dbang phyug gi /gnas mchog yin ces mdzes pa'i bkod pa mthong*/ /pad 'dab re re'i steng na grong khyer ni/ /bye ba khrag khrig mang pos gang ba la/ /de dbus gzhal yas khang chen phun tshogs kyi/ /dbus na rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med/ /g.yas g.yon spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen sogs/ /byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor ba mthong*/ /de tshe bud med ut+pal mdangs ldan ma/ /bdag la lta ste 'di skad gsal bar smra/ /gnas mchog 'di ni bde ba can yin te/ /rgyal ba 'di ni mgon po 'od dpag med/ /chos tshul 'di ni sgyu ma rmi lam tsam/ /chos rnams kun kyang 'di ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di ni rna ba'i yul du gsal/ dus der dag pa'i dbang gis rgyal ba la/ /bdag gis gus pa'i sems kyis 'di skad bstod/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i sems can bden med la/ /me long gzugs brnyan lta bu'i gzugs sku yis/ /spros bral chos sku mngon du ston mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la gus pas 'dud/ /zhes smras pa dang skad cig de nyid la/ mkha' spyod mchog gi dngos grub grub po zhes/ /bar snang khams su 'phur te phyin pa rmis/ /yang ni gnas der tho rangs nub cig dus/ /mkha' 'gro yin zhes bud med chas bzang bzhi/ /phyag na thod pa gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /nang na ring bsrel las grub rgyal ba'i yum/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga rang bzhin gyis byon pa'i/ /thod pa khyad 'phags bdud rtsis rab gang ba/ /sgrib med gzugs sku rab tu gsal ba zhig /bdag la gus pa'i sems kyis rab phul zhing*/ /de rjes bud med bzhi ma tshigs bcad re/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis rab tu smras pa thos/ /gsad dang ma gsad khyad med blo la gsal/ /yang ni tho rangs 'khrul pa'i rmi lam na/ /bdag nyid dus gsum mkhyen par rab gsal zhing*/

/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mu tig rgyal mtshan dang*/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i dra bas rab g.yogs pa/ /sgrub brgyud rgyal mtshan yin zhes phul ba rmis/ / zhes dang*/ rnam thar rin chen 'od phreng las/ skye ba gong ma'i chos skyong yin pa dang*/ /smon lam rnam dag btab pa de yi mthus/ /dpal ldan mgon po ber nag can dang ni/ /dpal ldan lha mo dang ni chos skyong dang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma la sogs gang dang gang*/ /dran pa tsam gyis thams cad mngon sum du/ /bzhugs sam snyam pa'i snang ba gsal ba ni/ /mig gi dbang po 'byed 'dzum khyad par med/ /mngon sum rig pa'i khyad par sna tshogs snang*/ /re zhig lha sar shākya mu ni'i drung*/ /rab rib 'khrul pa gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /dpal ldan chos rje rang byung rdo rje ni/ /mdzes pa'i sku la snyan pa'i gsung sgra can/ /dgyes zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal dang rab ldan pas/ /phyag na shel gyi phreng ba rab bsnams nas/ /bdag gis gtso byas mi tshogs dpag med la/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed rin po che/ /rab tu snyan pa'i gsung gis bsgrags pa dang*/ /rang gi blo la gdung shugs rab ldan pas/ /dad pa phun tshogs rab tu ldan pa'i mthus/ /mchi ma dpag med yun du byung ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma pham dpal ldan zhes/ /ming gi rjes su gnang ba mdzad pa dang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'od kyi rang bzhin du/ /gyur te rang gi lus la thim snyam byed/ /ces dang*/ jo mo'i drung du nub cig nyal ba'i tshe/ /dkar po'i rgyun ldan yid kyi snyam byed la/ /mkha' spyod ma nyid lhan cig skyes ma ru/ /gsal zhing de yi smin phrag gru gsum du/ /g.yung drung dmar po 'khyil zhing de yi 'od/ /rang gi lus la phog pas lus sems rnams/ /bde ba chen po'i ngang du song ba snyam/ /zhes ra tshag jo mo'i drung du bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang dang*/ re zhig shar gyi ri yi rtse mo nas/ /dar gyi rgyab yol la mu tig gis spras pa/

/de yi mdun du bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /kīrti sing ha zhes grags de nyid kyang*/ /gnas nang phyogs la zhal gzigs bzhugs pa na/ /mngon sum rig pa'i khyad par yad yud tsam/ / zhes dang*/ re zhig gsang sngags dbang chen bskur ba'i tshe/ /rab rib 'khrul pa gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /rgyal sras byams pa rol par bzhugs pa mthong*/ /dam chos po ti dpag bsam grangs med pa/ /sna tshogs snang zhing de tshe 'di skad gsungs/ /pho brang 'di dang dam chos 'di dag kun/ /mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya khyod kyi yin/ /mi pham sras po'i sku gzugs 'di nyid kyang*/ /ma 'ongs dus na khyod kyis 'grub par gyur/ /zhes pa bdag gi rna ba'i dbang pos thos/ /lha yi chas ldan mi tshogs dpag med kyis/ /rab tu gang dbus bdag nyid 'dug nas kyang*/ /mi pham zhabs la mgo bos gtugs nas ni/ /bstod pa sna tshogs rab tu byas pa snyam/ /gnyid sad tshe na mchi ma dpag med babs/ /re zhig sprin bral mkha' dbus chu shel dbang*/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rgyu zhing 'jig rten khams/ /'od kyis rab tu gang ba'i rmis ltas snang*/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang nyin mtshan med par nyams snang la/ /rdo rje phag mo 'gying bcas gar ldan pa/ /me long gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal bar mthong*/ /re zhig dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral sogs/ /rab tu gsal bar snang zhing bstod pa byas/ /rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rjer rab gsal zhing*/ /mkha' 'gro ma brgyad phyogs na rab gnas pa/ /yun ring bar du gsal ba'i snang ba byung*/ /de sogs mdo rgyud dbang dang gdams pa yi/ /nyams len bshad nyan gsan par byed pa'i tshe/ /ltas kyi khyad par sna tshogs snang ba yang*/ /rnam rtog yi ger bris pas mi lang bas/ /de lta mod kyi cung zhig bris pa rnams/ /dag snang ldan pa'i mos gus gso phyir dang*/ /gtan tshigs che ba 'don par bya ba dang*/ /nyams su len la brtson par bya phyir smras/

/zhes pa rnams 'byung ngo*// yang dran mang thugs rje'i lcags kyu las gnyid kyi rmi lam na o rgyan gyi gnas yin no snyam pa'i ri bo mchog tu mdzes shing*/ shin tu lhun sdug pa mtho khyad dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs pa'i brag ri dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i nags tshal yid du 'ong ba dang*/ rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa mang po dang*/ bde ba'i yo byad du ma dang ldan pa'i skye bo rgyan sna tshogs pas mngon par brgyan pa/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dang bu mo lta bu du ma dang bcas pa mthong ste/ mthong ba'i mod de nyid la 'di ni rmi lam mo snyam du dran pa skyes so/ /e ma ho rmi lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin grub pa cung zad cung zad kyang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang nye bar snang ba tsam 'di la yang dag par dpag ste/ sgyu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin mngon par sbyang ngo zhes bsam nas/ o rgyan ni/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rgyal chen dbang po'i blo'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ste/ de bas na bdag gis de'i zhabs kyi pad mo la phyag bya'o zhes sems pa na/ sprin gyi dbus 'ja' 'od kyis bskor ba'i lha'i bu me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa zhig 'di skad du/ gang du tha dad 'dzin dbang gis/ /du mar dmigs pa ji lta bar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul skus/ /rang bzhin med las du mar snang*/ /gang zhig phyogs gcig spyod pa'i blos/ /der ni de 'o snyam sems pa/ /bden min brdzun pa'ang ma yin te/ /ji ltar yongs su btags gsal tsam/ /rnam par dag pa min pa'i blo/ /yongs su sbyangs pa ma byas pa/ /

de dag ko ka li ka bzhin/ /rab mchog mchog tu dman par dmigs/ /blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo dag /thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa zhes/ /rnam mthong tshol bar rtsol ba'i blo/ /nyin mor byed dbus mun ji bzhin/ /zhes pa las/ de shin tu bden te/ de lta mod kyi kho bos rmi lam gyi sprul pa sprul te lan gdab bo/ /zhes de las mchog tu mdzes pa'i lha'i bu gnyis pa zhig /de'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bkod de smras pa/ /sred pa rnam par rmongs de dag /rmi lam na yang srin mo'i gzugs/ /lha yi bu mo bzhin dmigs te/ /dga' bar snang ba'i sdug bsngal 'dzin/ /dad pa'i rgyun ldan skal pa mchog /tshabs cher 'khrul pa nyid tshe na'ang*/ / mgon po 'tshol bar rtsol ba'i blo/ /sdug bsngal lta bu dga' bder ldan/ /shin tu blun pa'i blo gros can/ /skal ngan la chags de dag ni/ /bshes gnyen dam pa nyer 'tshol bas/ / rnam par dben pas don ldan nam/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang po bzhin/ /dkon mchog rin chen mchog dkon te/ /thams cad de lta ga la yin/ /yin na 'khrul 'khor spyod ci zhig /zhes pa la yang des smras pa/ /gso dpyad rig pa gang yang phan byed bzhin/ /blo gros ldan la brjod pa mtha' dag mdzes mod kyi/ /smra bder ldan yang gnyis 'dzin bkrol dka' ste/ /de bas 'ching byed srad bu rnam par bcad/ /zhes so// kye ma bdag gis brgal zhing brtag par bya ba ma yin te/ /gang dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyi tshul dran par bya'o/ /zhes nas lha'i bu gnyis pa de rang nyid la bsdus te gnas pa las de yang med par gyur te/ da ni bdag grong khyer chen po'i dbus su phyin la btsal lo snyam nas/ shar phyogs kyi sgo la zhugs te 'gro bar brtsam pa la/ skye bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gro ba'i gseb tu ma thar te/ steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas grong gi dbus su song ba na/ de dag ltad mo byed cing sna tshogs smra bar gyur to//

grong gi bzhi mdo'i steng gi nam mkha' la lha'i bu rnams kyis bzung ba'i bla re dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ me tog gi 'phreng ba dang*/ mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma mthong ste/ bdag nyid chen po de ni nges par 'di nyid na bzhugs so snyam nas shin tu dga' bas gang zhing myur bar song ba las/ baiḍūr+ya'i gzhi mchog tu dri ma med pa'i dbus gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan zla nyi'i bkod pas rab tu mdzes pa la cung zad 'gying bas bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug /g.yas g.yon lha mo dag gis mngon par mchod pa/ skye bo'i tshogs du mas phyag 'tshal zhing bkur stir bya ba dang*/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa mthong ngo*/ /da ni bdag gis kyang nam mkha' las bab ste 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbus su pad ma'i sdong po la gnas pa'i lha'i bu zhig bya'o snyam pa las/ mod de nyid la de ltar grub ste/ mchod sprin mngon par sprul te phul/ bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi yan lag du mas bstod/ rdo rje theg pa'i dbang gi nges pa dag ting ngi 'dzin gyis bsgrubs pa las ji ltar bsam pa de dang de ma tshang ba med pa phul du byung ba grub par mthong bas dga' ba dpe med pa brgya phrag du ma thob ste/ rmi lam rnam par sprul pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bkod pa ni de tsam zhes tshim pa skyes nas thams cad gdod nas 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid de de bas na de kho na nyid/ mchog tu zab mor bsdu ba'i tshul gyis gnas par bya'o/ zhes bsam pa na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag nyid chen po de mchog tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum pa mdzad de bka' stsal pa/ legs so rnal 'byor skal dang ldan/ /bde spyod bzang po mchog khyod legs/ /khyod 'phrul rab zab 'di lta na/ /rgyal ba mtha' dag mngon dgyes 'gyur/ /byis pa sgyu mar rmongs pa dag /bden par 'dzin pa'i srad bus bcings/ /gang 'di rin chen dben mthong pa/

/rnal 'byor dbang po rnam par grol/ /sgyu mar rig pa rig pa'i mchog /'dzin pa'i skal dang bral de dag /mi ring mi dman mi rnyed de/ /zab mor rtse gcig de mod la/ /e ma sa gsum las dgongs pa/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu dag bdag nyid/ /gzhom med snying po de kho na/ /skyob pa kun gyi phyag gi gnas/ /'di snang 'di tsam 'di nyid ches/ /'gro ba nye bar 'gro dbus su/ /mkha' dbyings yid bzhin 'od 'bar ba/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun mnyam sbyor/ /char yang thig le tshul sogs dang*/ /bdag gzhan rnal 'byor gsang ba'i gdan/ /rnal 'byor dbyibs sngags chos thams cad/ /gdod lha'i gdan sogs mtha' dag 'di/ /kye ho nam mkha' rab spyod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor bla na med bzang po/ /mkha' la gya gyu 'gro ba 'bum/ /dbang byed srid gsum kun dbang phyug /ces sogs rab tu mang po thos bzhin pa la gnyid sad de slar mos pa'i dbang gis gsol ba btab bo/ /zhes 'byung zhing*/ mkha' spyod ming don rnam gsal las rnal 'byor pa kho bo cag ni mtshungs med rje btsun bla ma mchog gi thugs rje'i mthus/ nyams kyi snang ba rab tu mtshar ba'i ltad mo dag la rtag par longs spyod de/ de la mngon rtags su 'dzin pa yang mi skye'o/ /ha cang bden dngos kyi zhen pa med bzhin du/ mig 'phrul dang mtshungs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug du mas mkha' spyod dbang po zhes btags shing yang dang yang du rdo rje'i glu len pa mthong bas/ dga' zhing chags pas ched du 'dzin pa med du zin kyang nyams kyi dbang gis dbang med du smras so// gzhan yang 'di ltar rmi lam gyi ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong ba'i skabs su bsam pa 'di lta bu dag skyes te/ chos thams cad sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam nyid du bde bar gshegs pas bstan par gyur ba nyid kyi phyir/ nges pa nyid du grub pa kho bo cag la 'dir mngon sum pas/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i bkod pa thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa kho nar gdon mi za ba nyid de/

de bas na bdag gis 'bras bu mthar thug pa'i ye shes bla na med pa mngon du gyur ba'i tshul gtan la dbab bo zhes bsams nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma las ches shin tu rgya che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dran par byas te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi gnas rnam par bkod pa'i rgyan yid la byas pa tsam gyis/ 'phral dang 'phral du ji ltar bsams pa de bas kyang ches shin tu lhag pa dag snang bar gyur pa na/ yid dga' ba dang spro ba tshad med pa dag skyes shing*/ de la rjes su 'dzin pa'i dri ma med par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i dran pa dang ldan pas/ snga ma la chags pa med cing phyi ma la thogs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mchog tu shugs dang ldan pa thob par gyur to// da ni bdag gis khyad par gyi bkod pa dag bsgrub par bya'o zhes nges par byas nas/ man ngag las 'byung ba ltar/ rin po che gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus/ baiḍūr+ya'i mtsho yangs shing rgya che ba mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi bkod pas mngon par bkra ba/ dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi rang bzhin gyi lhun po dpag tshad du ma dang ldan pa bang rim brgya phrag stong gis 'phags pa/ bang rim de dag kyang rin po che'i grong dang grong khyer du ma dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ me tog gi skyed mos tshal bdud rtsi'i mtsho rdzing 'bab chu'i bkod pa yid du 'ong ba rnams dang*/ yon tan gyi rnam pa du mas brgyan pa'i skye bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa longs spyod kyi khyad par phul du byung ba dang ldan pa'i rtser ri'i cog mdzes pa la 'dab bzang dbang po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dab gshog gis bar snang gi khams khyab pa/ de'i steng nor bu rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khri mchog tu yangs shing mtho ba so ldan gangs ri'i phreng ba lta bu gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha dang dra ba dra ba phyed pa du mas mdzes pa dang*/

mthon ka chen po'i mdog can gyi gdong lnga'i phreng bas khri 'phang 'og ma dang steng ma rim pas bteg pa/ bye ba brgya stong rab rgyas 'dab ma'i phreng ldan mtsho skyes dbang po'i ze 'brur/ snang byed rgyal po dang bsil zer byed pa dag mngon par bkod pa la/ bdag nyid dpal gar gyi dbang phyug /dbang phrug che mchog rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu grub pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dag na bdud rtsi'i sprin yid du 'ong ba'i dpal/ dga' bde'i sprin yid du 'ong ba'i dpal zhes mchog tu gyur pa'i lha dag gis nye bar btud pa/ steng nas ye shes kyi sprin phyogs mthar khyab pa'i 'od dang 'od kyi dra ba bsam yas mngon par 'bar zhing bar tu 'khyil ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi sprin 'dod dgu nye bar rtsol ba'i char zil mkha' khyab zad med yang dag 'bebs bzhin pa/ de dag la gnas pa'i lha'i bu mchog tu gyur pa du mas lha rdzas kyi mchod pa phul byung gzhal du med pas rnam pa thams cad du mchod cing bstod par byed pa/ de lta bu sems kyis rnam par bkod pa las/ ji ltar bkod pa bas ches lhag pa gsal bar grub ste/ 'dus skyes yid tsam skyod pa las skad cig gis 'og min gyi gnas su phyin te/ der rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang bzhugs so bar rtog pa'i mthu las nye bar snang ba rang la thim pas ro gcig tu byas te/ dpal ldan bde chen lhan skyes ye shes gsang ba chen po'i sku/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang bcas pa lhun rdzogs su bkod nas/ de las rnam par 'phrul pa mgon po rnam par snang mdzad sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku tshad med brjod du med pa dag kyang dran rdzogs su rnam par 'phrul te/ e ma 'di thams cad ni/ rang gi sems kyi 'jug pa mngon par bkra ba'o/ /sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'o/ /de lta na yang rnam par bkra ba'i ye shes kyi 'jug pa dbang po'i mtshon dang*/

pra sen ltar mngon par snang ba 'di ni ngo mtshar to/ /zhes rang gi nges pa la ting nge 'dzin bcings te 'dug pa na/ phyags phyogs nas bde gshegs sras bcas du mas dgyes pa skyed de legs so/ /zhes bstod par mdzad pa dang*/ pad+mo'i gdan can sogs 'jig rten skyong ba du mas mchod cing 'dud par yang snang ngo*/ /mkha' la spyod pa mchog 'og min gyi zhing sbyong ba'i lha gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa dran rdzogs rnam par bkod pa ni de tsam mo/ /zhes nye bar bsdus nas/ skad cig gis u rgyan gyi gnas dran par byas te dz+nyan ḍā ki mchod pa'i cho ga yang dag par bsgrubs pas tshim pa thob pa'i mod la gnyid sad par gyur to/ /bden pa med pa'i rmi lam gyi ri mo 'di la mtshon te yang mkha' spyod rnal 'byor zhes grub pa nyid do/ /rmi lam 'di nyid kyi tshigs su bcad pa byed po med pa nyid las rang grags pa yang 'di ltar/ kye kye rmi lam rnam 'phrul gyi/ /rig ldan rig pa chen po pa/ /sangs rgyas kun dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes gsang chen rab tu rdzoḍa/ /rig mchog grub gter bye ba 'bum/ / rab bzang cho ga ldan mchog legs/ /legs so mkha' la rang dgar spyod/ /ma lus chos rnams 'di kho na/ /pad mtsho yid bzhin lhun po'i rgyal/ /'dul skyes lag ldan gdong lnga dang*/ /'dab stong bsil zer nyin mor byed/ /bdud rtsi dga' bde sprin lha'i bu/ /mkha' spyod gar dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ /mchod sprin bye ba rgya mtsho 'bar/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dgyes pa/ /'di ni rmi lam rnam thar mchog /gang yang yod dang med de bzhin/ /de dag gam ni gzhan du'ang rung*/ /bden pa'i dngos po 'ga' tsam yang*/ /nges par kun tu mthong bas dben/ /dben la mngon dgas 'khyud blo can/ /dngos po'i gdon can kho na ltar/ / yongs su rnam grol dam pa'i don/ /snang ba'i phyogs mtshon spyod pa bzhin/ /phyogs dang ris su gang la la/

/yongs su gcod bkag rnam par bkag /rab 'gog 'gog pa nyid gzhan yang*/ /mkha' pad ltar gyur 'di ya mtshan/ /rab bkra sems kyi 'ja' ris 'bum/ /rab 'byams stong dbyings mkha' khyab pa/ /bden par kun tu rtog pa kun/ /rab yangs rab byed mnga' bdag mtshar/ /mkha' la spyod pas mkha' yi dpal/ /ma lus legs bsdus longs spyod rdzogs/ /mkha' sogs 'jig rten gsum rang bzhin/ /dbang byas rmad byung las rmad byung*/ /zhes sogs mang po dag ste/ 'dir ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig bkod do/ /zhes 'byung ngo*// sngon gnas rjes dran gyi rnam par thar pa'ang skye ba snga 'grel las/ spre'u lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i nya la/ lus dang sems cung zad ma bde ba'i dbang gis/ bla ma la gsol ba gdung shugs kyis btab pa'i tshe/ sems shin tu dngas par gyur te/ sngon rabs cung zad dran pa 'di lta ste/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas gong du smos pa'i gzhon nu gsang tshol du gyur tshul dang*/ tshul khrims dpal dang*/ nam mkha' 'od/ g.yag ru ras pa/ grags seng pa rnams kyi lo rgyus cung zad re 'byung zhing*/ dran mang thugs rje'i lcags kyu las/ yang re zhig 'di ltar bsams par gyur te/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog 'di sngon phyogs gang dang gang du sku 'khrungs shing*/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa de dang de'i tshe/ kho bo las ngan pa'i shugs kyis ci dang ci lta bur 'khor zhing song zhig gu /zhes rab tu gdung ba drag pos sems gdungs shing*/ yun ring zhig gsol ba btab ste gnas pa las brdzun gyi ri mo cung zad dran te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sū pa kīrtir gyur pa'i tshe/ bdag rma bya'i phru gu zhig tu gnas pa la ma shi ba'i rkyen gyis 'chi bar nye ba na/ bla ma mchog gi thugs rjes skyabs so/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ rje rin po che lus 'phags kyi gling du thub pa'i sras mo shes rab bzang mor gyur pa na/ bdag bung bar gyur pa char rlung drag pos nyam nyes te 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/

ngan song las bzlog par mdzad pa dang*/ nub phyogs u rgyan du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ bdag bram ze'i khyi'u lo bdun lon pa la/ dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad de/ chur mi byings ba sogs grub pa'i rtags phra mo dang ldan pa la 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ / zhes bya ba dang*/ yul ka ling ka'i rgyal por gyur pa na/ bdag nags khrod du rgyu ba stag gi phru gur skyes nas yun ring ma lon pa zhig tu gnas pa dmag gi mis brdzis te 'chi la thug pa na/ brtse bas yang dag par drangs pa dang*/ chu klung me tog pad+mas brgyan par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bdag ri dwags kyi bur gyur pa khyis bdas pa las bskyabs te/ ngan 'gro las bton pa dang*/ ba glang spyod kyi gling du sku 'khrungs pa na/ glang rdzi ma'i bur gyur pa skyes ma thag shi ba'i ro lam gyi bzhi mdor bor ba la/ byams shing brtse bar mdzad pa dang*/ yang gling de nyid du dge slong gi tshul gyis bzhugs pa na/ bdag me tog gi rtsa bar zhen pa'i srin bur gyur pa thugs rjes mtho ris su drangs pa dang*/ u rgyan gyi gling zur tir ti tar dka' thub mdzad pa na/ bdag spre'u phrug tu gyur pas shing thog phul zhing*/ 'brel pa thob bo zhes bya ba dang*/ gling phran dha ri thar bzhugs pa na/ bdag grong gi byis pa glang rdzir gyur pa la chos bstan par mdzad pa dang*/ baiḍūr+ya'i zhing du sems can gyi don mdzad pa na/ bdag mi'am ci'i mor gyur pa la/ dad pa'i sems bskrun par mdzad pa zhes bya ba rnams dang*/ 'di dag gis rkyen byas nas khyi dang phag dang yi dwags dang nad kyi rigs mi bzad pa mdze la sogs pas gzir ba'i lus shin tu sdug bsngal ba mang po dang*/ cung zad bde bde ltar snang ba'i skyes tshul sogs pa sems kyi skad cig re re la dus gnyis char gsal te/ rgyu des yid lhag par yang skyo zhing gdung ba drag po 'phel bas/ lhag par bla ma mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to//

rnam thar gsang sgrol las/ re zhig de bī koṭa dang nye ba'i mtsho gling na rgyal ba'i mchod rten byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ mtshan mo yang 'od rab tu 'bar ba dag yod de/ der bram ze skal ldan dang skal mchog ma'i bu mos ldan zhes rang gi nu bo bsad pa ne tshor skyes te shes pa mi gsal ba las skyo bar gyur nas mchod rten gyi drung du dad pa cher skyed de/ 'di skad ces blo ldan rmi lam gsal mthong sad bzhin du/ tshe rabs kun tu bdag ni dran ldan zhing*/ /zab yangs bla med snying por gyur ba'i chos/ /bdud rtsi rab rnyed rtag tu 'thung bar shog /ces yang dang yang du smon par byed do/ /yongs su 'dzin pa ni ḍā ki ma zhig ste dbang lam du byed pa'i man ngag kyang thob pa yin no zhes dran par gyur to// de nas de dang nye bar dhari ma'i khol po dga' ba zhes bya ste/ de ni slob dpon til+li pa'i man ngag gis grol ba'i sgo rnyed pa/ sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa rgya mtshos ngoms pa med pa nyid do/ /e ma me tog tshogs spang sbrang rtsir 'dod/ /de yis sbrang rtsi rnyed pa'i rgyu ni gang*/ /pad tshal bye bas ngom med rkang drug bdag /bla ma'i man ngag nam mkha'i lam la rtse/ /zhes brjod pa'ang dran no/ /de'i rjes su dza lan dhara'i yul du skyes pa rigs ngan khye'u kun rig / chung ngu nas thams cad du song song pa las yongs su 'dzin pa mang pos bka' drin byin te/ khyad par dpal ye shes dngos grub kyi man ngag thob pa u rgyan la sogs pa'i gnas su rgyu ba zhig go /zhes kyang ngo*// yang bal por gzhon nu gsang 'tshol zhes/ ātsar+ya badz+ra pā ni'i g.yog byas te man ngag rab tu 'tshol bar dga' zhing ngal ba med pa'o/ /'di dag gi snga logs su gar zha'i yul du byung ba'i dge bsnyen spro ba 'dzin la sogs 'ga' zhig mthong mod kyi chog par zad do/ /rje btsun sgam po pas rjes su bzung zhing cung zad lam gyi snang ba thob pa tshul khrims dpal zhes kyang byung ba yin no/

/de bzhin du dpal ldan bram ze chen po dngos su grub pa shrī dhar+m+ma kīrti'i zhabs kyis yang dag par smin grol du mdzad pa nam mkha' 'od ces grags pa yang rab du byung ngo*/ /yang dpal in+d+ra bhū tis byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud pa gcig rnam par dag pa gdams pa thob sgrub pa la brtson pa'i spyod pa can bkra shis grags pa zhes bya ba yang byung ngo*// ri bo chen po'i zhol du dka' thub mngon par spyod pa sprin 'dzin dang*/ grub pa'i gnas mang por song song ba rnal 'byor dril 'dzin dang*/ chu la mi bying par 'gro nus pa'-i rnal 'byor ma mes byin dang*/ nyi ma la ting nge 'dzin du byed pa mkha' grol dang*/ ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ gzhan dag gis mtshan mo me 'bar bar mthong ba'i kun tu rgyu gos med dang*/ gangs kyi khrod du rlung 'ba' zhig gis bde bar 'tsho ba spyod pa pa ste go rim dang*/ yul dus kyang rigs pa ha cang gsal bar ma rnyed pa la rang gi ngo bo rab tu bkra ba/ phyi ma 'di dag gcig dang*/ gzhan de lta bu'o/ /de 'dra ba'o/ zhes bya ba mang du byung mod kyis snying po med pa dag las kyang snying po med pa'i tshig bzhag ste/ 'di ni sngon tshul rjes dran gyi rnam par thar pa zhes bya ba brdzun gyi 'khor lo'i ri mo rnam par bkod pa bzhi pa'o/ /zhes cung zad 'god par mdzad do// ma 'ongs zhing sbyong gi rnam par thar pa'ang*/ rnam thar gsal sgron las/ kho bo cag gi mtshungs med bla ma dam pa ni rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid de/ de ni rgyal mchog 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor grub pas de'i zhing bde ba can du 'jug par 'dod pas/ bla ma mchog gi thugs rje'i 'dren byed dang rang gi mos pa'i 'phen byed shin tu drag pa'i phyir skad cig yud tsam kho na la phyin par nus so zhes gdengs bcas pa yin no/ rigs gsum mgon por dag ni ngo bo tha dad pa ma yin te/

de'i phyir mgon po kun tu gzigs pa'i zhing rab 'byams yongs su sbyong zhing lta ba yang gegs med par 'grub bo zhes bsam par gyur to/ /'phags pa'i lha sras dri ma med pa'i zhabs 'bring zhing*/ bzhed pa yongs su sgrub par 'dod pas rgyal ba byams chen gyi zhal mthong ba dang*/ chos thos pa rab tu dka' ba ma yin no zhes kyang nye bar rtog go /yongs su 'dzin pa mchog dpal sa ra ha pa dngos su grub pas dpal gyi ri'i bkod pa byin rlabs kyis snang bar mdzad cing*/ snang ba ji lta bar slar yang mthong bar sla'o zhes rtog pa brtan por skyes so/ /rje btsun 'di nyid dpal ldan dbang po'i blor nges shing skye ba mang por dz+nyā na ḍā' kis yang dag par gzung ba'i phyir thos 'dzin la sogs pa'i yul du dga' ba du ma dang bcas te 'khrid par mdzad do/ /zhes rgyud kyi nges pa las grub pa yin no// gzhan yang shar gyi phyogs rol du chu klung chen po dang*/ glang po sna ljags brkyang ba lta bu'i ri dang nye bar bsam gtan gyi gnas su bsam gtan byed do zhes bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi 'phen pa'i lhag mas byang phyogs kyi rgyud bla ma'i gnas su spyod cing de'i 'phrin las sgrub par byed do zhes dang*/ rje badz+ra rā dza'i byin rlabs kyis dgongs pa sgrub par dga' bas/ de'i gnas dang nye bar kun tu rgyu'i spyod pas 'jug go zhes mthong ba dang*/ mthar spyod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi bur byas te rdzas kyi nus pa mi zad pa'i gsang 'tshol bar byed do/ /zhes dang*/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas lhag par bgrod cing bdud rtsi 'thung bar dga' bas/ lan bzhi brgyud ma kho nar rtse zhing phyogs thams cad du 'gro'o/ /zhes dang*/ u rgyan dang kha che'i bar du slob dpon chen po la ba pa'i man ngag 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ tong kun dang nye bar rdzogs pa chen po la spyod par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la sogs pa nges pa du ma mthong yang bris shing brjod par mtha' gtugs par ma mthong ngo*/

/zhes 'byung ngo*// de dag gis gdul bya gus pa rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du rnam par thar pa'i cha shas las kyang cha shas tsam bstan par zad kyi/ 'phags chen rnams kyis skad cig ma re re'i sgyu 'phrul ting nge 'dzin gyi bkod pa'ang so so skye bos bskal bar brjod cing bsam par ga la nus te/ rje nyid kyi rnam thar gsang sgron du/ de la sogs pa dpag tu med pa snang mod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pas ma zin par rang gar snang ba dag las nyung shas bsdus pa las/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi kun spyod ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rim pa ni ma gtogs te/ da ni gnyid thun gcig la'ang mtha' yas pa snang ba'i phyir bsdu mi nus la/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang rmi lam gyi 'jug pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa la sogs ji ltar snang ba bzhin brjod na gzhan dag gi blor mi tshud de smod pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bri bar dga' ba las don med cing bris kyang mi lang ba'i phyir bzhag la/ 'di tsam zhig mthong zhing mthong ba las ni/ 'di lta bu 'byung ba ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes dang ba skye ba dang*/ rgyu des kho bo cag kyang 'di lta bu'i gnas thob par bya'o/ /zhes brtson pa'i lam la 'jug pa dang*/ 'di 'dra ba 'byung ba zhig gam/ 'on te ma byung ba brdzun gyi ri mo kho na zhes the tshom pa dang*/ ma byung nges so zhes nges par 'dzin pa de dag kyang 'dis rnam par grol ba'i rgyu mchog byed do/ /zhes bka' bstsal pa ltar rnam thar kun gyi spyi sdom yang*/ ring nas rjes bzung bla ma lhar bcas rnams/ /ring du dgongs par mdzad mod lhag par yang*/ /ring por 'khor ba'i blo can kho bo la/ /ring zhig dgongs pa de ring bskyed du gsol/ /sngon dus spyod pa'i dge bsnyen spro ba 'dzin/ /bar du grub pas rjes bzung nam mkha' 'od/ /'di na mkha' spyod dri med dpal ye shes/ /phyi dus sngags spyod rnal 'byor kun tu rgyu/

/dang por bdag gis rmi lam gru gzings rten/ /bzang ngan sprul la mchog dman rtog pa spangs/ /yul dus ched du bya ba sems la bzhag /byang chub rim lnga'i man ngag rtsal chen sbyangs/ /de nas sgyu ma'i khye'u sprul par bstan/ /mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo mgu bar byas/ /lus dang ngag yid tha dad 'ga' thun snang*/ /ro snyoms sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i man ngag rnyed/ /slar yang bdag ni 'phrul gyi skas them 'dzeg /'og ma ma bor gong mar ma chags la/ /bar mar mi gnas rdzu 'phrul rkang gis bgrod/ /mthar byed gsang ba'i man ngag lam du byas/ /de nas smig rgyu'i chu yis khrus byas shing*/ /'ja' tshon bkra ba'i gos zung rnam par brgyan/ /mig gi skyes bu'i grogs kyis mthar brten te/ /dri za'i grong khyer rab 'byams lta zhing dong*// de nas rang lus gser gyi bum pa grub/ /gtsug rgyan brgya byin thog pa'i nor bu rnyed// yin bzhin pad mo'i snying po snying la bstim/ /lha dbang 'dzin pa'i me tog rab 'byams mthong*/ /slar yang tshangs sras lha mos man ngag sbyin/ /khab kyi rtse mor nam mkha'i mchod rten brtsegs/ /gter gyi bum bzang dgos dgu char du phab/ /dga' mgu rangs pa'i bsams pa rnam par dag /de nas bdag ni ri dbang rtse mor song*/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i chos kyi rnga chen brdungs/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten 'od kyis rab tu bkang*/ /'chi med bde chen gsang ba'i go 'phang rnyed/ /slar yang dang po'i mgon po snying gar sad/ /bde chen rdo rje mkha' la brten par gnas/ /tha mal shes pa kun bzang mgon po'i zhal/ /rang dga'i gzuḍa brnyan skyes bu'i mig gis mthong*// da ni 'di la phyogs med dus bral bas/ /sgro btags 'khrul pa'i sgrung 'bum su zhig gleng*/ /'on kyang cir yang 'char bas de bzhin nyid/ /gang du brjod kyang don la ji ltar 'gal/ /de phyir bla ma lhar bcas ma lus kun/ /mkhyen gzigs sgrib med 'od gsal dag pa'i spyan/

/chos kun bden nam brdzun pas chos 'di yang*/ /bden dang brdzun par 'grub la mkhyen par gsol// e ma mig gi skyes bu gang las 'phos/ /me long gzugs brnyan phyi ma gang du skye/ /mo gsham bu mo'i skye rgyud rnam pa du/ /'on kyang 'di la don gyi gsang 'bum gnas/ /'di ltar rdzu 'phrul rkang stobs rgyas pa'i lus/ /'gro ba kun gyi bran du khas blangs nas/ /thar pa'i lam la yud kyis 'dren byed pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni cang shes dbang po'i tshul/ /sus kyang btab med sa bon bye ba las/ /nus pa bsam yas 'bras bu so sor smin/ /kun nas skye dgu kun la bde ster ba/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni rab tu brtan pa'i tshul/ /myang 'das nyin byed 'od kyis ma bskams shing*/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos la/ /gnyis la ma brten gnyis dang ma bral bas/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni chu skyes dbang po'i tshul/ / bzang ngan thams cad shong pa'i yangs pa la/ /phra rags kun gyi khyab pa'i mjug pa can/ / yod med mtha' las 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni rab yangs nam mkha'i tshul/ /dbyibs legs kha dog bkra zhing 'od gsal ba/ /rang gi ngo bo gzung med mthong dang bral/ /kun gyi yid 'ong ltad mo'i 'os gyur pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni bar snang 'ja' yi tshul/ /gang la mgon byas de zhabs gtsug tu 'dzin/ /bsgo ba'i ngag nyan spyod pa'i drag shul bzod/ /bdog pa kun gtong gzhar yang mi 'dor bas/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni khol po des pa'i tshul// phyi yi yul snang nang du mi yin zhing*/ /nang gi shes pa phyi rol rgyu ba spangs/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du dben byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni dka' thub spyod pa 'dra/ / 'jug dang ldog pa'i lam ni nges byas shing*/ /gsal stong myang byed bde ba'i nor bu 'dzin/ /mda' yi shugs kyis bgrod pa'i spyod pa can/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni 'phongs sgrog dbang po'i tshul/ /'og tu lhung yang 'og tu 'pho ba med/

/steng tu song yang steng tu slar gsheḍa shing*/ /steng 'og med par khyab pa'i zil dngar can/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni char sprin g.yo ba'i tshul/ /nyan rang dman pa'i ma las rab byung zhing*/ /ting 'dzin sgo nga'i sbubs las nges grol te/ /zab yangs snying po'i tshul la kun spyod pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni gnyis skyes dbang po'i tshul/ /gang 'tshams gzugs kyi spu sdug mdzes pa'i tshul/ /bdud rtsi'i char la dga' ba'i gar sgyur zhing*/ /'dod yon dug gi tshul mgur spyod pa can/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni rab mdzes rma bya'i tshul/ /bdag 'dzin ri dwags za zhing ri khrod rgyu/ /kha ba'i ri ngos lhag par dga' ba 'phel/ /byin rlabs rmad byung g.yu ral mdzes pa can/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni ri dwags dbang po'i tshul/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs chu bo bye ba bltams/ /gnad kyi gdams pa rin chen 'bum gyi mdzod/ /nyams rtogs klu dbang brgya yi rol pa can/ / rnal 'byor bdag ni rab zab rgya mtsho'i tshul// dge legs mtshan bzang 'bum gyi dpal 'bar ba'i/ /stong gsal mtshar sdug btsun mo bye bas bskor/ /phul byung bsam yas bde ba'i rol mo can/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshul/ /lus kyi yan lag spyod pa'i tshul brgya dang*/ /rjes mthun glu dbyangs 'gyur ba rnam pa stong*/ /lhan cig yid dmigs gang la rtse gcig pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni gar mkhan gzhon nu'i tshul/ /kun gyi sngon 'gro kun gyi rjes su'ang 'jug /dog cing mi thung mgyogs lam rnam pa bkag /gzhung lam gsal ston 'gro ba'i mig gcig pu/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni lam mkhan mkhas pa'i tshul/ /phyi dang nang dang bar la mi dmigs kyang*/ / gcig dang du ma bral nyid kun tu snang*/ /byis pa'i mig lam mdzes pa'i dga' skyed pa/ / rnal 'byor bdag ni chu zla gar mkhan tshul/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes gling bzhir dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /yan lag rab mchog rin chen bdun gyis phyug

/dbang phyug chen po'i gnas brgyad dbang byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal tshul/ /de ltar bdag tshul chos rnams thams cad de/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin bdag gi tshul/ /bdag gzhan dbye ba med phyir gang du 'grub/ /e ma 'di tshul rnam par bsdu ba'i sgo/ /rnam pa mang du brjod kyang zad med kyi/ /nyung ngu'i nyung du gsang ba'i sgron mar phye/ /brjod la dge ba srid na srid pa 'dir/ /mi srid len pa'i 'gyur bas tshim gyur cig /ces so// de nas dgung lo nga drug pa la bab pa'i tshe dga' ldan ma mor phebs nas phyag dpe rnams phyag rtags kyis mnan zhing phyogs 'dir myur du sleb par 'dug gsungs/ khams pa'i grwa slob kyis nan gyis spyan 'dren zhus pa la/ lam du rten 'brel mi 'grig pa 'dug gsungs kyang nan zhus kyis chu nyil bar byon der sgar phebs ma thag chos 'phro rnams tshar ba mdzad de/ /cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul gyis/ shing mo bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer dgu la gshegs par bstan/ sku gdung rin po che mdo li la spyan drangs te dga' ldan ma mor gser 'bum gyi bum par bzhugs su gsol ba sogs dge slong dbon grags pa dang*/ ba yo chos bzang bas bsgrubs so// de ltar mkha' spyod pa'i rnam thar 'di nyid gong gsal ltar/ rje nyid kyi gsung dngos bka' 'bum du bzhugs pa rnams gung bstun nas rgyas pa'i khul du sbyar ba ste/ slob ma rnams kyis sbyar ba'i rnam thar zhib mo med 'dug pas/ 'gos lo dang*/ rje dpa' bo'i chos 'byung du'ang mdzad pa thun mong ba'i rnam thar rgyas pa mi 'byung ba bzhin 'dir yang de tsam du bas so//

༈¿¿bu slob ni gtso bor rje de bzhin gshegs pa ste phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha khrid sogs gsung gi zin bris kyang du ma mdzad/ sog dbon rig ral gyis kyang chos gsan pa'i rgya dpal mkha' spyod pa kho na che/ gzhan yang rdza dgon pa chos kyi ye shes/ zur dgon bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal/ ri mi 'babs pa bsod nams rin chen/ chab kha ba shes rab dpal/ 'ger nyag rtogs ldan/ srid dkar sangs she/ lha gzigs pa/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum/ ba yo chos bzang ba/ dpon grags pa/ bla ma rin bzang dkar po sogs gzhan don nus pa mang du byung ba las/ ༈¿¿rdza dgon kun spang pa ni/ rdza dgon du bzhugs nas phrin las bskyangs/ dgon 'di dang po phag mo gru pa'i dgon lag yin na'ang rin po che 'di'i ring nas/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang po'i chos lugs la spyod cing gus pa sgom par byed do// ༈¿¿bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal gyis ldan sga stod du zur dgon btab/ ri gling gnyis su yod pa la dge 'dun bzhi brgya tsam 'du/ ༈¿¿chos rje ri mi 'babs pa ni/ chu pho stag la 'khrungs te/ mkha' spyod pas bcu gsum bzhes pa'i lo'o/ /dge ldan pa la gtugs nas rab tu byung ba'i kun tu spyod pa rnams rnam par dag par mdzad/ mkha' spyod pa la gtugs nas dus rtag tu phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par 'jog ste/ go gnyis pa zhes pa chu mo bya lor dwags po la bar du gshegs/ ༈ 'ger nyag rtogs ldan gyi yul sbom 'bor sgang chung ba yin/ dpal mkha' spyod pa'i zhabs la gtugs shing gdams pas rjes su bzung*/ ri khrod kho na 'grim pa la grwa pa mang dus lnga brgya drug brgya tsam 'ong ba byung*/ de'i slob ma gzhan don skyong ba mang du byung ba la/ ༈¿¿chos rje dri med pa ni/ 'jang rgyal po'i ti shrir gzhan don bskyangs/ ༈¿¿sri dkar sangs she ni/ yul spom 'bor sgang pa/ mkha' spyod pa la rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas sbom 'bor sgang du+u sa ser dgon pa btab nas phrin las sgrub par mdzad de dge 'dun sum brgya tsam 'dus de ni gtso bor 'ger nyag gi slob ma'o//

༈¿¿lha gzigs pa ni/ dang po 'bri gung pa'i gzim g.yog pa yin/ dus phyis mkha' spyod pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gdams pas rjes su bzung bas thugs dam phun sum tshogs par gyur/ phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs sogs gsung rnams la zin bris mdzad pas phan pa yang che bar byung*/ stod smad thams cad du byon zhing gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen shākya grags pa yin te/ dang por mkha' spyod pa nyid la'ang thug mod kyang gdams pa'i zhib tshags thams cad lha gzigs pa la brten nas gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma dpag tu med pa bsten nas 'gro don yun ring du bskyangs nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa shing pho khyi'i lo la gshegs/ ༈¿¿'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum ni/ gnas nang dang nye ba'i g.yu ma zhes par 'khrungs nas mkha' spyod pa la sogs pa la chos mang du gsan nas/ gnas nang gi gdan sar bzhugs/ chos rje mkha' spyod pa'i gsung la zin bris su mdzad nas bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid yig chen mo la sogs mdzad/ 'di'i slob ma slob dpon lcags rdo bla ma rgyal mtshan pa la sogs pa yin no// ༈ bla ma chos bzang pa ni/ 'khrungs yul nags shod pa/ mkha' spyod pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gdams pa thams cad zhus/ stag rtse dang ba yo'i gdan sa mdzad nas phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ ༈ dge slong dpon grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ dwags po sku rabs pa'i zhal ngo yin par thos/ rtse lha sgang gi gzim khang dang dga' ldan ma mo sogs 'debs pa'i phyag len mdzad pas kar bstan la phyag rjes shin tu che/ ༈ bla ma rin bzang dkar po ni/ 'khrungs yul nags shod pa/ dgon pa grib gdong btab nas 'tshogs pa'ang brgya tsam 'dus te mkha' spyod pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzad cing*/ 'di dang ba yo chos bzang gis sprul sku chos dpal ye shes kyi bla mar mdzad//
